fields.name: Rice
fields.description: Major staple cereal crop requiring strong water support.
fields.planting_note: Best in puddled fields with reliable irrigation during wet periods.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid when water is low or irrigation is not available.

fields.name: Yellow Corn
fields.description: Versatile cereal crop adaptable to many field conditions.
fields.planting_note: Use good seed spacing and maintain moderate moisture during tasseling.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid prolonged flooding or very high standing water.

fields.name: Cassava
fields.description: Drought-tolerant root crop suitable for low-input systems.
fields.planting_note: Use healthy cuttings and weed early in the first month.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid waterlogged soils for long periods.

fields.name: Sweet Potato (Camote)
fields.description: Short-cycle root crop with strong tolerance to variable moisture.
fields.planting_note: Plant on raised beds and keep vines healthy during establishment.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid persistent flooding and compacted soils.

fields.name: Mungbean
fields.description: Legume crop suited to dry windows and low-input farms.
fields.planting_note: Use well-drained fields and avoid planting during heavy rainfall peaks.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid saturated fields and prolonged rainy spells.

fields.name: Peanut
fields.description: Nitrogen-fixing legume preferring lighter, well-drained soils.
fields.planting_note: Maintain loose topsoil for proper pod development.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid heavy clay with poor drainage.

fields.name: Soybean
fields.description: Protein-rich legume suitable for moderate moisture and neutral pH.
fields.planting_note: Best with neutral soil and moderate rainfall.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid strongly acidic and flooded conditions.

fields.name: Coconut
fields.description: Perennial tree crop with broad adaptation in tropical systems.
fields.planting_note: Provide spacing and maintain weed-free circles at establishment.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid very dry sites without supplemental moisture.

fields.name: Coffee
fields.description: High-value perennial requiring good moisture and drainage balance.
fields.planting_note: Use shade management and mulch in early growth phases.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid severely dry and highly alkaline conditions.

fields.name: Cacao
fields.description: Perennial crop needing humid conditions and regular moisture.
fields.planting_note: Maintain shade and consistent soil moisture.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid prolonged dry stress.

fields.name: Abaca
fields.description: Fiber crop thriving in humid tropical conditions.
fields.planting_note: Good moisture and partial shade improve stand vigor.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid dry areas without rainfall support.

fields.name: Rubber
fields.description: Long-term plantation crop for suitable perennial systems.
fields.planting_note: Choose well-drained sites and maintain weed control in early years.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid shallow, dry, and drought-prone soils.

fields.name: Sugarcane
fields.description: Commercial cane crop requiring open fields and medium to high resources.
fields.planting_note: Use clean seed cane and maintain fertility for ratoon success.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid very low water and nutrient-deprived sites.

fields.name: Banana
fields.description: Tropical fruit crop suited to moderate to high moisture.
fields.planting_note: Maintain sucker selection and wind protection where possible.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid prolonged drought and poorly managed water stress.

fields.name: Mango
fields.description: Fruit tree preferring good drainage and dry flowering periods.
fields.planting_note: Encourage canopy airflow and avoid stagnant water around roots.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid waterlogged clay lowlands.

fields.name: Pineapple
fields.description: Fruit crop favoring well-drained soils and moderate moisture.
fields.planting_note: Maintain drainage and clean field sanitation.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid heavy flooding and poorly drained clay.

fields.name: Calamansi
fields.description: Citrus crop with moderate adaptability to Philippine conditions.
fields.planting_note: Support with regular pruning and nutrient management.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid prolonged waterlogging and severe drought.

fields.name: Avocado
fields.description: Perennial fruit tree suitable for well-drained and moderately moist sites.
fields.planting_note: Protect young trees from strong winds and standing water.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid lowland flooding conditions.

fields.name: Onion
fields.description: High-value bulb crop favoring dry periods and good drainage.
fields.planting_note: Use raised beds and strict moisture control near harvest.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid heavy rainfall windows and high standing water.

fields.name: Garlic
fields.description: Bulb spice crop suited to dry season and light soils.
fields.planting_note: Ensure proper spacing and avoid overwatering.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid high humidity and poorly drained fields.

fields.name: Tomato
fields.description: Common vegetable crop requiring balanced moisture and loam soil.
fields.planting_note: Stake plants and monitor disease during humid weeks.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid constant heavy rains and waterlogging.

fields.name: Eggplant
fields.description: Resilient vegetable with good productivity in warm conditions.
fields.planting_note: Use proper spacing and prune old leaves for airflow.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid prolonged flooding and saturated soils.

fields.name: Okra
fields.description: Warm-season vegetable with moderate drought tolerance.
fields.planting_note: Harvest regularly to maintain pod quality.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid heavy flooding and prolonged cold-wet conditions.

fields.name: Ampalaya
fields.description: Vining vegetable favoring warm weather and moderate watering.
fields.planting_note: Use trellis support and maintain regular but not excessive watering.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid persistent waterlogging and severe flooding.

fields.name: String Beans
fields.description: Leguminous vegetable suited to moderate moisture and good drainage.
fields.planting_note: Provide staking for climbing types and monitor pod borers.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid overly wet soil conditions.

fields.name: Cabbage
fields.description: Cooler-condition vegetable for managed or upland settings.
fields.planting_note: Perform best in cooler windows and controlled watering.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid hot-dry lowland stress periods.

fields.name: Squash
fields.description: Adaptable vegetable crop with broad field suitability.
fields.planting_note: Use proper spacing and pollination-friendly field management.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid severe water stress during fruit set.

fields.name: Ginger
fields.description: Spice crop favoring moist but well-drained conditions.
fields.planting_note: Use disease-free rhizomes and maintain mulch cover.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid long drought periods and compacted soils.

fields.name: Lettuce
fields.description: Leafy vegetable requiring mild conditions and careful irrigation.
fields.planting_note: Prefer cooler planting windows and frequent light watering.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid extreme heat and prolonged dry stress.

fields.name: Pechay
fields.description: Short-cycle leafy vegetable for quick harvest cycles.
fields.planting_note: Keep soil moisture consistent and harvest at marketable size.
fields.avoid_note: Avoid severe drought and unmanaged heat stress.
